categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in pharmaceutical manufacturing and sales, producing both general and specialized medicines such as eye drops, capsules, and injections. It also engages in the sale and rental of medical devices and welfare products through its subsidiary KJ Care, focusing on elderly care equipment and medical devices. Additionally, the company has expanded into renewable energy, specifically solar power generation and electricity sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced pharmaceutical synthesis and formulation technologies, including organic synthesis for new compounds and improved drug formulations for enhanced efficacy and patient convenience. It operates automated production lines for pharmaceuticals and has introduced automated mask manufacturing lines. Research and development focus on novel drug synthesis, bio-drugs, and improved drug delivery systems, supported by in-house manufacturing and quality control facilities compliant with GMP standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers include pharmacies, clinics, hospitals, and wholesalers across South Korea. The company targets specialized therapeutic areas such as ophthalmology, cardiovascular, diabetes, and infectious diseases. Its subsidiary serves the elderly care market with medical and welfare devices. The company also pursues export markets and engages in licensing agreements for drug commercialization domestically and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with headquarters in Seongnam and manufacturing facilities in Ansan. It serves nationwide markets through regional sales offices. It has licensing and research collaborations extending to countries including China, Japan, the United States, and others. The renewable energy business is focused on domestic solar power generation at its Ansan plant.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, including drug synthesis, formulation, manufacturing, and distribution. It sources raw materials both domestically and internationally and sells finished pharmaceutical products and medical devices to healthcare providers and wholesalers. It also licenses out and in drug technologies, indicating involvement in upstream innovation activities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing new drugs and improved formulations in key therapeutic areas such as ophthalmology, diabetes, cardiovascular diseases, and inflammation. The company invests in bio-drugs and biosimilars, with ongoing clinical trials and joint research collaborations. It emphasizes innovation in drug delivery and synthesis methods, patent acquisition, and expanding high-value-added products. Additionally, it is developing renewable energy capabilities to enhance ESG performance and future growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of pharmaceutical products to healthcare providers and wholesalers. Additional income streams include sales and rentals of medical and welfare devices via its subsidiary, licensing-out agreements for drug technologies, and electricity sales from solar power generation. The company also receives milestone and royalty payments from licensing contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major Korean pharmaceutical firms such as Yuhan, Chong Kun Dang, Daewoong, Green Cross, and Hanmi Pharmaceutical. It holds a mid-tier market position with steady sales growth but faces intense competition in generic and specialty drug markets. Its focus on niche therapeutic areas and licensing partnerships supports differentiation. The subsidiary operates in the growing elderly care device market, which is competitive but expanding.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 135 billion KRW with a net loss due to restructuring and tax adjustments. It has shown revenue growth of over 6% year-on-year but experienced operating losses recently. Total assets increased by nearly 20%, supported by capital investments and land revaluation. The subsidiary posted positive net income and aims for sales growth through market expansion. The company maintains moderate leverage with a capital adequacy ratio around 18.6%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality pharmaceutical products with advanced formulations targeting unmet medical needs, such as improved eye drops and combination therapies. It leverages patented technologies and proprietary synthesis methods to differentiate its product portfolio. Its integrated R&D and manufacturing capabilities enable rapid development and commercialization. The subsidiary offers specialized elderly care devices aligned with demographic trends. The renewable energy business enhances corporate sustainability and social responsibility.
